formula: D/V*((k21 - al)*(k31 - al)/((al - be)*(al - ga))*exp(-al*x) + (k21 - be)*(k31 - be)/((be - al)*(be - ga))*exp(-be*x) + (k21 - ga)*(k31 - ga)/((ga - al)*(ga - be))*exp(-ga*x))

notes: hybrid rates from the trigonometric solution of the cubic
